podcast.body: A tribute record dedicated to blues singer Junior Kimbrough, a significant influence on Dan Auerbach, who was a big fan of Kimbrough in high school. "and a tribute record called Chula Homa, which is dedicated to a blue singer named Junior Kimbrough."
